title: एकषष्ट्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 261 · Rama's exile and the coming of Ravana

summary.en: Rama and his brothers are born to Dasharatha, but on the eve of Rama's consecration Manthara rouses Kaikeyi, who demands Rama's exile and Bharata's kingship. Rama goes to the forest with Lakshmana and Sita; Bharata refuses the throne, Rama slays Khara and Dushana in Janasthana, and the wounded Shurpanakha's complaint brings Ravana to Maricha.
summary.kn: ದಶರಥನಿಗೆ ಶ್ರೀರಾಮ ಮತ್ತು ಸಹೋದರರು ಜನಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಪಟ್ಟಾಭಿಷೇಕದ ಮುನ್ನಾದಿನ ಮಂಥರೆ ಕೈಕೇಯಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಚೋದಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಕೈಕೇಯಿ ಶ್ರೀರಾಮನ ವನವಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಭರತನ ರಾಜ್ಯವನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಶ್ರೀರಾಮನು ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣ ಸೀತೆಯರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭರತನು ಸಿಂಹಾಸನ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಶ್ರೀರಾಮನು ಜನಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಖರದೂಷಣರನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡ ಶೂರ್ಪಣಖೆಯ ದೂರಿನಿಂದ ರಾವಣನು ಮಾರೀಚನ ಬಳಿ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: दशरथ के यहाँ श्रीराम और उनके भाई जन्म लेते हैं, पर राज्याभिषेक की पूर्वसन्ध्या पर मन्थरा कैकेयी को भड़काती है, जो श्रीराम का वनवास और भरत का राज्य माँगती है। श्रीराम लक्ष्मण और सीता के साथ वन जाते हैं; भरत सिंहासन ठुकराते हैं, श्रीराम जनस्थान में खर-दूषण को मारते हैं, और घायल शूर्पणखा की शिकायत रावण को मारीच के पास ले आती है।
summary.te: దశరథునికి శ్రీరాముడు, సోదరులు జన్మిస్తారు; పట్టాభిషేకపు ముందురోజు మంథర కైకేయిని ప్రేరేపిస్తుంది, కైకేయి శ్రీరాముని వనవాసం, భరతునికి రాజ్యం కోరుతుంది. శ్రీరాముడు లక్ష్మణుడు, సీతలతో అడవికి వెళ్తాడు; భరతుడు సింహాసనాన్ని నిరాకరిస్తాడు, శ్రీరాముడు జనస్థానంలో ఖరదూషణులను సంహరిస్తాడు, గాయపడిన శూర్పణఖ ఫిర్యాదుతో రావణుడు మారీచుని దగ్గరకు వస్తాడు.
summary.ta: தஶரதனுக்கு ஸ்ரீராமரும் சகோதரர்களும் பிறக்கிறார்கள்; முடிசூட்டு விழாவின் முன்னாள் மந்தரை கைகேயியைத் தூண்ட, அவள் ஸ்ரீராமரின் வனவாசத்தையும் பரதனுக்கு அரசையும் கேட்கிறாள். ஸ்ரீராமர் லக்ஷ்மணனுடனும் ஸீதையுடனும் காடு செல்கிறார்; பரதன் அரியணையை மறுக்கிறான், ஸ்ரீராமர் ஜனஸ்தானத்தில் கர தூஷணரைக் கொல்கிறார், காயமுற்ற ஶூர்ப்பணகையின் முறையீட்டால் ராவணன் மாரீசனிடம் வருகிறான்.
summary.ml: ദശരഥന് രാമനും സഹോദരന്മാരും ജനിക്കുന്നു; രാമന്റെ പട്ടാഭിഷേകത്തിന്റെ തലേന്ന്, മന്ഥര കൈകേയിയെ ഇളക്കിവിടുന്നു; അവൾ രാമന്റെ പ്രവാസവും ഭരതന്റെ രാജത്വവും ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു. രാമൻ ലക്ഷ്മണനോടും സീതയോടുമൊപ്പം കാട്ടിലേക്ക് പോകുന്നു; ഭരതൻ സിംഹാസനം നിരസിക്കുന്നു; ജനസ്ഥാനത്ത് രാമൻ ഖരനെയും ദൂഷണനെയും വധിക്കുന്നു; മുറിവേറ്റ ശൂർപ്പണഖയുടെ പരാതിയിൽ രാവണൻ മാരീചന്റെ അടുത്തെത്തുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.261; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
उक्तं भगवता जन्म रामादीनां पृथक्पृथक् ।
प्रस्थानकारणं ब्रह्मञ्श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथ्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: Blessed one, you have told of the births of Rama and the others one by one. Brahmin, I now wish to hear why they set out; please tell me.

verses.text:
कथं दाशरथी वीरौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।
प्रस्थापितौ वनं ब्रह्म मैथिली च यशस्विनी ॥

meaning.en: How did the two heroic brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, sons of Dasharatha, come to be sent to the forest, along with the renowned princess of Mithila, Sita?

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
जातपुत्रो दशरथः प्रीतिमानभवन्नृपः ।
क्रियारतिर्धर्मपरः सततं वृद्धसेविता ॥

meaning.en: King Dasharatha, now with sons born to him, was happy; he delighted in sacred rites, kept to dharma, and always served the elders.

verses.text:
क्रमेण चास्य ते पुत्रा व्यवर्धन्त महौजसः ।
वेदेषु सरहस्येषु धनुर्वेदे च पारगाः ॥

meaning.en: In time his mighty sons grew up, masters of the Vedas with their secret teachings and of the science of the bow.

verses.text:
चरितब्रह्मचर्यास्ते कृतदाराश्च पार्थिव ।
यदा तदा दशरथः प्रीतिमानभवत्सुखी ॥

meaning.en: O king, once they had completed their student vows and taken wives, Dasharatha was glad and content.

verses.text:
ज्येष्ठो रामोऽभवत्तेषां रमयामास हि प्रजाः ।
मनोहरतया धीमान्पितुर्हृदयतोषणः ॥

meaning.en: Rama was the eldest of them; wise and charming, he delighted the people and gladdened his father's heart.

verses.text:
ततः स राजा मतिमान्मत्वात्मानं वयोऽधिकम् ।
मन्त्रयामास सचिवैर्धर्मज्ञैश्च पुरोहितैः ॥

meaning.en: Then the thoughtful king, feeling himself advanced in years, took counsel with his ministers, knowers of dharma, and with the priests.

verses.text:
अभिषेकाय रामस्य यौवराज्येन भारत ।
प्राप्तकालं च ते सर्वे मेनिरे मन्त्रिसत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: O Bharata, the question was Rama's anointing as heir apparent, and all those best of counselors agreed that the time had come.

verses.text:
लोहिताक्षं महाबाहुं मत्तमातङ्गगामिनम् ।
दीर्घबाहुं महोरस्कं नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजम् ॥

meaning.en: They saw Rama red-eyed, long-armed, walking like a rutting elephant, broad-chested, with dark curling hair,

verses.text:
दीप्यमानं श्रिया वीरं शक्रादनवमं बले ।
पारगं सर्वधर्माणां बृहस्पतिसमं मतौ ॥

meaning.en: radiant with splendor, a hero no less than Indra in strength, versed in all dharma, and equal to Brihaspati in wisdom.

verses.text:
सर्वानुरक्तप्रकृतिं सर्वविद्याविशारदम् ।
जितेन्द्रियममित्राणामपि दृष्टिमनोहरम् ॥

meaning.en: He was loved by all his subjects, skilled in every branch of learning, master of his senses, and pleasing to look upon even for his enemies.

verses.text:
नियन्तारमसाधूनां गोप्तारं धर्मचारिणाम् ।
धृतिमन्तमनाधृष्यं जेतारमपराजितम् ॥

meaning.en: He was the restrainer of the wicked, the protector of the righteous, steadfast, unassailable, a conqueror never conquered.

verses.text:
पुत्रं राजा दशरथः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनम् ।
संदृश्य परमां प्रीतिमगच्छत्कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: O delight of the Kurus, King Dasharatha looked on this son, the joy of Kaushalya, and felt supreme happiness.

verses.text:
चिन्तयंश्च महातेजा गुणान्रामस्य वीर्यवान् ।
अभ्यभाषत भद्रं ते प्रीयमाणः पुरोहितम् ॥

meaning.en: Reflecting on Rama's virtues, the mighty and splendid king, well pleased, said to his priest: "May good come to you.

verses.text:
अद्य पुष्यो निशि ब्रह्मन्पुण्यं योगमुपैष्यति ।
संभाराः संभ्रियन्तां मे रामश्चोपनिमन्त्र्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: Tonight, Brahmin, the star Pushya will enter an auspicious conjunction. Let the preparations be gathered for me, and let Rama be invited."

verses.text:
इति तद्राजवचनं प्रतिश्रुत्याथ मन्थरा ।
कैकेयीमभिगम्येदं काले वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this royal command, Manthara went to Kaikeyi and at the right moment said this:

verses.text:
अद्य कैकेयि दौर्भाग्यं राज्ञा ते ख्यापितं महत् ।
आशीविषस्त्वां संक्रुद्धश्चण्डो दशति दुर्भगे ॥

meaning.en: "Today, Kaikeyi, the king has proclaimed your great misfortune. Unlucky woman, an enraged and fierce serpent is about to bite you.

verses.text:
सुभगा खलु कौसल्या यस्याः पुत्रोऽभिषेक्ष्यते ।
कुतो हि तव सौभाग्यं यस्याः पुत्रो न राज्यभाक् ॥

meaning.en: Fortunate indeed is Kaushalya, whose son will be anointed. Where is your good fortune, when your son has no share in the kingdom?"

verses.text:
सा तद्वचनमाज्ञाय सर्वाभरणभूषिता ।
वेदीविलग्नमध्येव बिभ्रती रूपमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Understanding her words, Kaikeyi, adorned with every ornament and bearing a beauty like a golden figure standing at the altar,

verses.text:
विविक्ते पतिमासाद्य हसन्तीव शुचिस्मिता ।
प्रणयं व्यञ्जयन्तीव मधुरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: came to her husband in private, smiling faintly with a pure smile, as though showing her affection, and spoke sweet words:

verses.text:
सत्यप्रतिज्ञ यन्मे त्वं काममेकं निसृष्टवान् ।
उपाकुरुष्व तद्राजंस्तस्मान्मुच्यस्व संकटात् ॥

meaning.en: "O king true to your word, grant me the one wish you once promised me, and so free yourself from this predicament."

verses.text: राजोवाच

meaning.en: The king said:

verses.text:
वरं ददानि ते हन्त तद्गृहाण यदिच्छसि ।
अवध्यो वध्यतां कोऽद्य वध्यः कोऽद्य विमुच्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: "Gladly I will give you a boon; take whatever you desire. Shall someone who deserves no death be killed today, or someone who deserves death be freed?

verses.text:
धनं ददानि कस्याद्य ह्रियतां कस्य वा पुनः ।
ब्राह्मणस्वादिहान्यत्र यत्किंचिद्वित्तमस्ति मे ॥

meaning.en: Whose wealth shall I grant, or whose shall be seized? Except what belongs to Brahmins, whatever wealth I have is yours."

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
सा तद्वचनमाज्ञाय परिगृह्य नराधिपम् ।
आत्मनो बलमाज्ञाय तत एनमुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, she held the king fast and, knowing her own power over him, said:

verses.text:
आभिषेचनिकं यत्ते रामार्थमुपकल्पितम् ।
भरतस्तदवाप्नोतु वनं गच्छतु राघवः ॥

meaning.en: "Let Bharata have the consecration that has been prepared for Rama, and let Rama go to the forest."

verses.text:
स तद्राजा वचः श्रुत्वा विप्रियं दारुणोदयम् ।
दुःखार्तो भरतश्रेष्ठ न किंचिद्व्याजहार ह ॥

meaning.en: Hearing these unwelcome words, with consequences so terrible, the king, afflicted with grief, O best of the Bharatas, said nothing at all.

verses.text:
ततस्तथोक्तं पितरं रामो विज्ञाय वीर्यवान् ।
वनं प्रतस्थे धर्मात्मा राजा सत्यो भवत्विति ॥

meaning.en: Then mighty Rama, learning of what his father had been told, set out for the forest, thinking, "Let the king's word hold true."

verses.text:
तमन्वगच्छल्लक्ष्मीवान्धनुष्माँल्लक्ष्मणस्तदा ।
सीता च भार्या भद्रं ते वैदेही जनकात्मजा ॥

meaning.en: The glorious Lakshmana, bow in hand, followed him, and so did his wife Sita, daughter of Janaka, princess of Videha. May good come to you.

verses.text:
ततो वनं गते रामे राजा दशरथस्तदा ।
समयुज्यत देहस्य कालपर्यायधर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: When Rama had gone to the forest, King Dasharatha met the end of his body, as all things must in time.

verses.text:
रामं तु गतमाज्ञाय राजानं च तथागतम् ।
आनाय्य भरतं देवी कैकेयी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing that Rama had gone and the king was dead, Queen Kaikeyi summoned Bharata and said:

verses.text:
गतो दशरथः स्वर्गं वनस्थौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।
गृहाण राज्यं विपुलं क्षेमं निहतकण्टकम् ॥

meaning.en: "Dasharatha has gone to heaven, and Rama and Lakshmana are living in the forest. Take the vast and peaceful kingdom, its thorns removed."

verses.text:
तामुवाच स धर्मात्मा नृशंसं बत ते कृतम् ।
पतिं हत्वा कुलं चेदमुत्साद्य धनलुब्धया ॥

meaning.en: The righteous Bharata answered her: "A cruel thing you have done! Out of greed for wealth you killed your husband and ruined this family.

verses.text:
अयशः पातयित्वा मे मूर्ध्नि त्वं कुलपांसने ।
सकामा भव मे मातरित्युक्त्वा प्ररुरोद ह ॥

meaning.en: You stain of your house, you have hung shame upon my head. Be satisfied, mother," he said, and wept aloud.

verses.text:
स चारित्रं विशोध्याथ सर्वप्रकृतिसंनिधौ ।
अन्वयाद्भ्रातरं रामं विनिवर्तनलालसः ॥

meaning.en: Then, having cleared his character in the presence of all the subjects, he went after his brother Rama, longing to bring him back.

verses.text:
कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च सुदुःखितः ।
अग्रे प्रस्थाप्य यानैः स शत्रुघ्नसहितो ययौ ॥

meaning.en: Very grieved, he sent Kaushalya, Sumitra, and Kaikeyi ahead in carriages, and went along with Shatrughna,

verses.text:
वसिष्ठवामदेवाभ्यां विप्रैश्चान्यैः सहस्रशः ।
पौरजानपदैः सार्धं रामानयनकाङ्क्षया ॥

meaning.en: with Vasishtha and Vamadeva, thousands of other Brahmins, and the townsfolk and countrymen, wishing to bring Rama home.

verses.text:
ददर्श चित्रकूटस्थं स रामं सहलक्ष्मणम् ।
तापसानामलंकारं धारयन्तं धनुर्धरम् ॥

meaning.en: At Chitrakuta he saw Rama with Lakshmana, bearing his bow and wearing the garb that adorns ascetics.

verses.text:
विसर्जितः स रामेण पितुर्वचनकारिणा ।
नन्दिग्रामेऽकरोद्राज्यं पुरस्कृत्यास्य पादुके ॥

meaning.en: Rama, obeying his father's word, sent Bharata back, and Bharata ruled from Nandigrama, placing Rama's sandals before him.

verses.text:
रामस्तु पुनराशङ्क्य पौरजानपदागमम् ।
प्रविवेश महारण्यं शरभङ्गाश्रमं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: But Rama, fearing the townspeople might come again, entered the great forest toward the hermitage of Sharabhanga.

verses.text:
सत्कृत्य शरभङ्गं स दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः ।
नदीं गोदावरीं रम्यामाश्रित्य न्यवसत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: After honoring Sharabhanga he went to the Dandaka forest and settled by the lovely Godavari river.

verses.text:
वसतस्तस्य रामस्य ततः शूर्पणखाकृतम् ।
खरेणासीन्महद्वैरं जनस्थाननिवासिना ॥

meaning.en: While Rama lived there, a great enmity arose with Khara, who dwelt at Janasthana, because of what Shurpanakha had done.

verses.text:
रक्षार्थं तापसानां च राघवो धर्मवत्सलः ।
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि जघान भुवि रक्षसाम् ॥

meaning.en: To protect the ascetics, Rama, who loved dharma, killed fourteen thousand rakshasas on that ground.

verses.text:
दूषणं च खरं चैव निहत्य सुमहाबलौ ।
चक्रे क्षेमं पुनर्धीमान्धर्मारण्यं स राघवः ॥

meaning.en: Having slain the very mighty Dushana and Khara, the wise Raghava made the forest of dharma safe again.

verses.text:
हतेषु तेषु रक्षःसु ततः शूर्पणखा पुनः ।
ययौ निकृत्तनासोष्ठी लङ्कां भ्रातुर्निवेशनम् ॥

meaning.en: When those rakshasas were killed, Shurpanakha, her nose and lips cut off, went to Lanka, to her brother's palace.

verses.text:
ततो रावणमभ्येत्य राक्षसी दुःखमूर्छिता ।
पपात पादयोर्भ्रातुः संशुष्करुधिरानना ॥

meaning.en: The rakshasi, faint with pain and her face dried with blood, reached Ravana and fell at her brother's feet.

verses.text:
तां तथा विकृतां दृष्ट्वा रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः ।
उत्पपातासनात्क्रुद्धो दन्तैर्दन्तानुपस्पृशन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing her so disfigured, Ravana, dizzy with rage, leapt from his seat, grinding his teeth.

verses.text:
स्वानमात्यान्विसृज्याथ विविक्ते तामुवाच सः ।
केनास्येवं कृता भद्रे मामचिन्त्यावमन्य च ॥

meaning.en: Sending his ministers away, he spoke to her in private: "Who has done this to you, good lady, scorning me without a thought?

verses.text:
कः शूलं तीक्ष्णमासाद्य सर्वगात्रैर्निषेवते ।
कः शिरस्यग्निमादाय विश्वस्तः स्वपते सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Who takes a sharp spear and presses it against his whole body? Who puts fire on his head and sleeps contentedly, trusting?

verses.text:
आशीविषं घोरतरं पादेन स्पृशतीह कः ।
सिंहं केसरिणं कश्च दंष्ट्रासु स्पृश्य तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: Who here touches a deadly serpent with his foot? Who stands and touches the fangs of a maned lion?"

verses.text:
इत्येवं ब्रुवतस्तस्य स्रोतोभ्यस्तेजसोऽर्चिषः ।
निश्चेरुर्दह्यतो रात्रौ वृक्षस्येव स्वरन्ध्रतः ॥

meaning.en: As he spoke so, flames of fiery energy poured from the openings of his body, as from the hollows of a burning tree at night.

verses.text:
तस्य तत्सर्वमाचख्यौ भगिनी रामविक्रमम् ।
खरदूषणसंयुक्तं राक्षसानां पराभवम् ॥

meaning.en: His sister told him everything: Rama's prowess, and the defeat of the rakshasas with Khara and Dushana.

verses.text:
स निश्चित्य ततः कृत्यं स्वसारमुपसान्त्व्य च ।
ऊर्ध्वमाचक्रमे राजा विधाय नगरे विधिम् ॥

meaning.en: Having decided what must be done, he comforted his sister, arranged matters in the city, and set off through the sky.

verses.text:
त्रिकूटं समतिक्रम्य कालपर्वतमेव च ।
ददर्श मकरावासं गम्भीरोदं महोदधिम् ॥

meaning.en: Crossing Trikuta and the mountain Kala, he saw the great ocean, deep-watered, home of sea monsters.

verses.text:
तमतीत्याथ गोकर्णमभ्यगच्छद्दशाननः ।
दयितं स्थानमव्यग्रं शूलपाणेर्महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Passing beyond it, Ravana, the ten-faced, came to Gokarna, the quiet and beloved place of the great trident-bearing god Shiva.

verses.text:
तत्राभ्यगच्छन्मारीचं पूर्वामात्यं दशाननः ।
पुरा रामभयादेव तापस्यं समुपाश्रितम् ॥

meaning.en: There Ravana went to Maricha, his former minister, who had taken up an ascetic life out of fear of Rama.
